objective: Make the Blood candidate decision observable at the first missing evidence edge without changing selection, legality, resource consumption, encounter authority or reference data.
current_plan: Extend the existing Blood survival observation to selected Blood Boil and Death and Decay decisions when Death Strike or Heart Strike candidates are present. This records whether DS/HS were absent, rejected, or valid during the area-action decision and keeps the existing Heart Strike fallback and native rune gates unchanged.
completed_work: The clean tank_threat_300 window loaded Death Strike 49998 and Heart Strike 55050 in bucket 1, selected Death and Decay/Blood Boil in the six-target lane, passed tank safety/threat/mitigation checks, and remained non-certifying because its simulator reference conditions were incompatible.
known_blockers_and_prior_retries: The earlier DS-versus-HS inversion is already repaired and disproven for the current loaded profile. The current calibration record does not retain candidate-level Blood observations, so a Magmaw decision cannot yet distinguish an absent profile row from a native eligibility rejection or a valid lower-priority fallback.
proposed_change: Change only BotBloodDecisionObservation::Attach and its focused serializer coverage so a selected Blood area action (48721 or 43265) carries the existing DS/HS candidate state when either candidate is present. Do not add or remove a candidate, alter scores, alter rune predicates, or change encounter-scoped Heart Strike admission.
forbidden_changes: Do not change the Blood SQL profile rows, priority buckets, scores, spell costs, rune legality or target selectors.
Do not add Heart Strike to a profile, relax encounter area-damage safety, or change Magmaw route/target authority.
Do not change WoWSims/reference data, role thresholds, coefficients, gear, stats or calibration semantics.
Do not claim actor_30002, any other actor, performance, raid clear or parent completion from the observation change.
Do not remove the existing one-rune Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
acceptance_conditions: A Blood candidate set containing DS/HS still serializes the same candidate validity, rejection reason, bucket and score fields when DS or HS is selected.
A selected Blood Boil or Death and Decay action serializes the same DS/HS candidate state when those candidates are present; a set without DS/HS remains unchanged.
The focused production-text C++ fixture passes with warning-as-error compilation and the existing Blood SQL/comparator test remains green.
The change is independently reviewed, built with the frozen host12 policy, and exercised in one exact cleaned tank role window before any actor or raid acceptance is considered.
